The official storage article currently states 90 days for purchasing-agent parcels and 60 days for forwarding parcels, counted from Warehoused status. It warns that goods may be treated as abandoned and destroyed when the limit passes without shipment or feedback. Check each order’s deadline and the current policy in your account.

The return/exchange guarantee article distinguishes quality issues from change-of-mind requests. It says buyers cover shipping for eligible returns without a quality issue, while the seller covers it for a confirmed quality issue after a request. Resale condition, seller rules and the applicable service terms still matter. Check the current terms before assuming a request is free.
